gaps.sentence: They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).

gaps.sentence: The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.

gaps.sentence: Looking back ___ it, the risk was worth taking.
gaps.explanation: look back ON something = remember and think about the past.

gaps.sentence: Feel free to drop ___ for a coffee any time.
gaps.explanation: drop in = pay a casual visit; drop off = fall asleep or deliver.
